contracts.routing_evidence: Service::dali_specialized implements EXT_ONLY plus every source-pinned read-only typed extraction plan: DALI_ONLY, FULL, REFRESH_STATUS_INFO, and RETRIEVE_RECONCILE. DALI_ONLY and FULL execute their exact 15-step and 18-step native sequences, decode line masks, device types, common/read-only parameters, all 16 scene levels, LED/emergency/GTIN/serial data, and (for FULL) the complete extended map. Each plan stages one snapshot and commits only on the captured active PCI generation with no replay. COND_QUICK and COND_EXTENDED execute only the retained POLL_FINISH_DISCOVER_KNOWN_FULL_INFO/MISSING read-only prefix; RESCAN_FAULT first executes retained non-remediating RESCAN. All three discard staged masks and stop before ADDRESS_UNKNOWN because operation 2 carries no allocation target/range and returns only a mask with no device-to-address receipt.

Direct and resolved one-to-six-bridge targets support direct, paged/NCC, OEM eDLT/GIU/SGIU/DALI and GOC/GOCBYT/GOC2 writes with none/checksum protection and native lock protection for direct/paged/NCC. Success rechecks stable record and manifest digest, stores decimal version/provenance, and reports its actual physical disposition. Incomplete writes fault the lane and are never automatically retried; SIMULATE validates with no PCI I/O. Proprietary patchset.zip remains unsupported (native_cgate_pp_programmer.json; programming.rs and service/system tests).
